conventions.convention: V is finite and nonempty, m is outside V, L,N≥1, and the survival schedule strictly decreases from α₀=1 to αN=0. Forward masking is independent across coordinates conditional on the clean string.
Reverse step j maps level j to j−1; all coordinate updates use the same current state and are conditionally independent. The sampler starts at m^L and c₁=1 removes all remaining masks.
The reverse-KL identity uses risks conditional on the positive event that the particular coordinate is masked; zero predicted true-token probability gives infinite cross-entropy and KL.

The finite ELBO corollary assumes full-support token predictions at every masked state and AC for the cited library KL theorem; exact endpoint prior and decoder factors equal one on forward-positive paths.

load_bearing.statement: For a fixed clean sequence x and 0≤s<t≤N, on every positive-probability current state conditional on x, the earlier-state posterior factors across coordinates, copies unmasked tokens, and at a masked coordinate assigns probability (αs−αt)/(1−αt) to xᵢ and (1−αs)/(1−αt) to m.

For the stated finite forward chain and learned product reverse kernels, the sum of expected conditional reverse KL contributions equals ΣⱼΣᵢ(αⱼ₋₁−αⱼ)Rⱼ,ᵢ as an equality of extended nonnegative quantities, where Rⱼ,ᵢ is conditional masked-token cross-entropy.

Under full-support clean-token predictions at every masked reverse state, for each clean x the finite model evidence satisfies 0<Zx≤1, the forward path law is supported where the model posterior is positive, and its required absolute weighted logarithm sum is finite.
The stated reverse coordinate product rows are probability vectors; composing the N kernels from the point mass at m^L gives a normalized finite law whose final state lies in V^L because c₁=1.
For r≥1 finite nonempty coordinate alphabets and probability vectors uₖ,vₖ, D(⊗ₖuₖ‖⊗ₖvₖ)=ΣₖD(uₖ‖vₖ), including infinite values.
For N≥1 pairs of probability kernels on a finite nonempty state space, initial TV error at most εinit and uniform row errors at most εⱼ imply endpoint TV error at most min{1, εinit+Σⱼεⱼ}.

concerns.concern: Fact F5 says “the finite feature/label/action spaces”. The action space is Δ(V), which is infinite whenever |V|≥2. Proof step 1.1 correctly equips it with its inherited Borel sigma-algebra and proves loss measurability, so this is a wording defect in F5 rather than a failure of the argument.
